newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates says gets new cargo automation system.
newsitem.headline: Emirates says gets new cargo automation system.

text.p: Emirates airline said it had acquired a new cargo automation system called Cougar which it predicted would "revolutionise" the way it does business.
The new system was introduced by its information technology affiliate Mercator which acquired Cougar from Swissair's IT subsidiary Atraxis.

"Cougar will be tailored to Emirates Sky Cargo's requirements to provide a service that is branded Skynet," it said. "Cougar will also enhance the services and information available to Equation subscribers from Emirates."
Equation is Mercator's cargo community system used by cargo agents in the UAE.
Emirates said Skynet would go live in May 1998.
"The enhancements are full integration of sales, marketing and distribution systems, increased efficiency and free flow of information to customers," the airline said. - Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
